brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has filed a defamation suit worth 2.6 million shekels against multiple media outlets and journalists, Shehab Wire reported. The lawsuit follows press reports that Netanyahu alleges constitute libel, according to the agency.

The legal action has sparked broad controversy within Israel's media and political landscape. Details of the specific allegations and which outlets face suit remain under dispute in Israeli public discourse.
dek: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has filed a defamation suit worth 2.6 million shekels against multiple media outlets and journalists, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Netanyahu sues Israeli media outlets for 2.6 million shekels over defamation claims
